T:P2.1.text: North America's Leading Metal Coatings Company - About AZZ

T:P2.2.text: Learn about AZZ, North America's leading metal coatings company, delivering galvanizing, coil coating, and advanced metal coating solutions.

T:P2.3.text: Industry-leading provider of metal coating solutions supporting everyday life

T:P2.4.text: AZZ Inc. is North America’s leading independent provider of hot-dip galvanizing and coil coating solutions serving a broad range of end markets. Collectively, our business segments provide sustainable, unmatched metal coating solutions that enhance the longevity and appearance of the buildings, products and infrastructure people rely on every day.

T:P2.5.text: Meeting the needs of diverse and evolving markets

T:P2.6.text: AZZ combines large-scale galvanizing operations, integrated coil coating capabilities, and advanced surface technologies to help customers improve corrosion protection, operational efficiency, product quality, and long-term performance. Backed by an extensive network of facilities and specialized coating technologies, AZZ helps customers access the solutions, capacity, and technical support needed to meet changing business demands.

T:P2.7.text: North America’s largest hot-dip galvanizer of fabricated steel

T:P2.8.text: AZZ Galvanizing provides industry-leading corrosion protection solutions that help extend service life, reduce maintenance requirements, and improve lifecycle performance across critical infrastructure and fabricated steel applications. As North America’s largest hot-dip galvanizer, AZZ combines scalable capacity, decades of galvanizing expertise, and a commitment to consistent quality and responsive customer support.

C:P1.4.text: The first-choice partner to meet customers’ evolving needs for innovative paints, coatings and surface solutions.

C:P1.6.text: Our global teams work every day to develop and deliver the paints, coatings and specialty products that our customers have trusted for more than 140 years. Explore our businesses and the markets they serve.

C:P1.7.text: We've got you covered with industry-leading transparencies, coatings, sealants, engineered materials and services designed to maximize aircraft performance across the entire lifecycle.
